title: 第十一章 大补精气第十二章 山外来人
content_zh:
原本只以为这十全汤方只是改了一下药性，提高了一下关键点，未曾想只是这么轻轻一变却又有了翻天覆地的变化。
这十全大补汤他此前也喝过。
药性说是有，但是却并不是真的强悍到一定程度，只能说是缓慢的滋补，需要长久的服用。
更何况如今这药性也不确定。
药材质量不管在哪个时代都不是那么好，确定的非得有经验的老师傅走南闯北，才能知道这玩意儿的真实与否。
结果没成。
如今在这面板上得到的这一个小小的汤方竟然如此的霸道，仅仅只是融合了气息吐纳变化，就已经恐怖到这种程度。
也就是现如今宋风的呼吸法早就已经充盈，能够通过呼吸引导滋养自己的身体，使得体内骨血迸发出生机藏住这一股药性。
要不然，一般的老头子到了他的年纪喝一剂这汤方，别说是增长气息，孕育生机了，估计一碗汤药就能送去见祖宗。
向着外面看去。
就在这喧嚣的风儿之中，只看到一只双眼滴溜滴溜直转，看着就精气四溢的那老二，此刻也是活动起了筋骨。
以前的时候，八段锦五禽戏这种养生之术老二学的认真但却打不出那股精气神，可能也是年纪的限制，根骨没长成，多少差那么点事。
如今看来，在这股药性的加持之下，他体内的那股气血更是沉着，呼吸间压着的那股劲儿更加狠唳霸道。
小小年纪还未成年，但是却硬生生的打出来了练拳十几年的那股筋骨力。
看起来只是些养生的手段，仅仅只是抻筋拔骨的炼法，并没有什么太厉害的杀招，在内行看门道外行看热闹，只看他绷起的大筋就知道这一下子究竟多厉害。
老大已经把这功练到了骨子里。
以前的时候慢吞吞的但是却蕴含着一股子的力，如今在这股药性的激发之下，遇敌如同火烧身，动作更加刚猛，霸道，反倒是有一股阴阳交融的意味。
这俩徒弟一直在那打拳锻体。
两个小子尽管已经累的全身上下都淌出了汗液，却仍然不停顿，甚至拳法一遍一遍的打，五禽戏一遍一遍又一遍的来。
一遍比一遍标准。

一遍比一遍有精气神。
原本看起来他们两个还是跟着宋风学习带着一股子标准劲儿，如今两个人连番打闹之下身上却又有了不一样的意味。
看起来像是同一个师父教的同样标准，但是老大有股阴阳共济的意味，老二刚猛霸道出拳更加阳刚。
看到这两个兄弟在这忙的不行。
看着地下已经被这一股汗水打湿，宋风则是带着一股笑意看了一眼这两个兄弟，随即烧开了一壶热水将它放凉。
甚至一壶还不够，又多烧几壶烧在了大瓦罐中，就在那瓦罐中放凉之后，宋风调了些盐弄了些蜂蜜往里面调和一下。
等到装完这两子水之后，他则是笑眯眯的看着两个徒弟，胸膛之中的气息也开始慢慢的沉淀下来。
整个人的气息若有若无但却充盈到全身的皮骨肌肉，甚至原本因为上了年纪，略微有些褶皱的表皮，似乎也被一股气撑起来了一样。
可惜终究还是上了年纪气血不足。
content_en:
I originally thought that this Shiquan decoction recipe just changed the medicinal properties and improved the key points. I never thought that such a slight change would lead to earth-shaking changes.
He had also drank this Shiquan Dabu Decoction before.
It is said to have medicinal properties, but it is not really powerful to a certain extent. It can only be said to be a slow nourishment and needs to be taken for a long time.
What's more, the properties of this medicine are now uncertain.
The quality of medicinal materials is not that good no matter what era it is. You must have an experienced master to travel far and wide to know whether this stuff is real or not.
It didn't work out.
Now this little Tang Fang obtained on this panel is so overbearing. It is already terrifying to this extent just by incorporating the changes of breath and breath.
That is to say, Song Feng's breathing method has already been fully developed, and he can nourish his body through breathing guidance, so that the bones and blood in the body burst out with vitality and hide this medicinal property.
Otherwise, if an ordinary old man reaches his age and drinks a dose of this soup, not to mention increasing his breath and giving birth to vitality, a bowl of soup can be sent to his ancestors.
Look outside.
In this noisy wind, I could only see one eye rolling around, and the man who was full of vitality at the sight was also moving his muscles at this moment.
In the past, the second child learned the health-preserving technique of Ba Duan Jin and Wu Qin Xi seriously but could not produce that kind of vitality. It may be due to the limitation of his age, and his bones have not grown up, so he was more or less in trouble.
Now it seems that with the blessing of this medicine, the energy and blood in his body are even calmer, and the energy pressed in his breath is even more fierce and domineering.
He is still underage at a young age, but he has developed the strength of his muscles and bones that he has practiced boxing for more than ten years.
It seems to be just some methods of maintaining health, just stretching the muscles and pulling out the bones, and there is no too powerful killing move. The expert can see the secrets and the outsider can watch the excitement. Just look at his stretched muscles and you will know how powerful this is.
The boss has practiced this skill to his core.
In the past, it was slow but contained a burst of power. Now, under the stimulation of this medicine, meeting the enemy is like burning the body, and the movements are more fierce and domineering, but there is a sense of yin and yang blending.
The two apprentices have been boxing and exercising there.
Even though the two boys were tired and sweating all over their bodies, they still didn't stop. They even punched each other over and over again, and performed the Five Animals play over and over again.
Compare the standards again and again.
More energetic than ever.
Originally, it seemed that the two of them were still following Song Feng with a standard spirit, but now they had a different meaning as they continued to fight.
It looks like they were taught the same standards by the same master, but the eldest one has a sense of yin and yang, while the second one is more masculine with his fierce and domineering punches.
I saw these two brothers were very busy here.
Seeing that the ground was already wet with sweat, Song Feng glanced at the two brothers with a smile, then boiled a pot of hot water and let it cool down.
Even one pot was not enough, so he boiled a few more pots in a large earthen pot. After letting it cool in the earthen pot, Song Feng mixed some salt and some honey to mix it in.
After filling up the two bottles of water, he looked at the two apprentices with a smile, and the breath in his chest began to slowly settle down.
The breath of the whole person is vague but full of the skin, bones and muscles of the whole body, and even the skin that is slightly wrinkled due to age seems to be held up by a breath of air.
It's a pity that after all, I am still old and have insufficient energy and blood.
